C-SNAPSHOT-ANCHORING-REDESIGN.IntentSummary: Replace the package-version-coupled full-capture durable store with a content-addressed behaviour-policy snapshot plus a per-family pointer, keep a family binding stable across /reload and server restart with CLI --force as the only reset, never persist credentials, isolate store failures per family so plugin load never fails, add --force to the preset, plugin, and role commands, and move orchestration policy injection to the request tail. Delivers AC-01 through AC-10 of the approved GraceChangeSpec. Draft pending explicit user approval of the completed plan; no implementation has started.

MustPassCommand.Command: bun test src/runtime/snapshot-config.test.ts src/runtime/snapshot-store.test.ts src/runtime/snapshots.test.ts src/runtime/context.test.ts

PlanningNotes.Note: Approval provenance: the user approved the GraceChangeSpec C-SNAPSHOT-ANCHORING-REDESIGN and invoked grace-plan. This plan stays draft until the user approves the completed plan; no implementation has started.

Pre-plan preflight on 2026-10-03: grace lint --path . --assertions current and grace lint --path . --parallel-preflight both pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings; the active-baseline phases are valid because no observed writes have begun.

Measured budgets on the reference host: the targeted runtime baseline suite completes in roughly 1.5 seconds and bun run typecheck in roughly 13 seconds; the full bun run check is the whole-project gate and is budgeted by the runner default.

Probe-first ordering is deliberate: T-001 must run before T-007 because the tail-injection shape and the documented fallback depend on real-host behavior, and its /reload finding decides whether the binding lookup is module-scoped or runtime-scoped.

Behaviour-relevant projection is the load-bearing idea: the snapshot stores resolved model selections, plugin policy values, and the orchestration profile, and excludes every credential field and every package-version-derived field, so a package upgrade cannot change the content hash.

Fail-soft is absolute: plugin load and unrelated families must never fail because of snapshot state; a corrupt or missing pointer or snapshot rebinds the affected family to the current configuration with a bounded diagnostic rather than throwing.
No final-review obligation is declared by the source. Any reviewer the controller independently requests is optional, not a recorded gate.

GRACE lifecycle commands (grace lint, grace status, and --assertions baseline, target, final) are external execution gates and must never be nested in a MustPassCommand or in task verification; the installed-package harness bun run e2e:v2 is substrate-heavy and is used as acceptance evidence in T-001 and T-009 rather than as a gate.
The legacy data directory is never read and never automatically deleted; the fix release performs a one-time rebind of existing families to the current configuration, which is documented in README.
Execution entrypoint after plan approval is the grace-execute skill with this plan; the host stays on the pinned 2.1.3 release until the redesign release ships.

T-001.Title: Establish pinned-host probe evidence for reload survival, tail injection, and child rebind.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Determine on the pinned 2.0.18 host whether native /reload resets plugin-context or module-scoped runtime state, record the observation, and record the resulting binding-lookup placement decision (module-scoped store versus runtime-scoped store).

Determine whether a transient text block appended to the last message in the native session context hook reaches the provider request, observed through the native request hook, and record the exact accepted shape.

Determine whether changing a child session expected model across a rebind causes the model guard to reject that child next request, and record the observed behavior together with the chosen mitigation.

Add read-only probe evidence rows or a scenario to the installed-package harness scripts/e2e-v2 without changing product source, and record all findings in the change design-context Scenarios; the normative spec is not edited.

T-002.Title: Define the credential-free, version-independent behaviour projection and content hash.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Define the behaviour-relevant projection covering resolved model selections for root, roles, and agents including variant qualifiers, plugin policy and toggle values, and the orchestration profile, as an explicit typed value.
Implement canonical deterministic serialization and a sha256 content hash whose result does not depend on property insertion order.
Exclude every credential field such as apiKey and every package-version-derived field such as $schema and $id from the projection and therefore from the hash.

Add tests proving credential absence in serialized output, an identical hash across a simulated package version and schema URL change, and a deterministic hash across property order and repeated calls.
Update the module contract, module map, and change summary to credit this change.

T-003.Title: Replace the capture store with content-addressed snapshots and per-family pointers.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Write each policy snapshot to a file named by its content hash and each family binding to a pointer containing familyId, snapshotHash, and boundAt, using atomic temp-then-rename writes with restrictive permissions.
On read, recompute the content hash and return undefined on mismatch, missing file, or parse failure; never throw for corrupt or absent state.
Never read the legacy snapshot directory, and never write a credential value to disk.
Provide reference enumeration and removal primitives needed for pointer cleanup and unreferenced-snapshot garbage collection.
Add tests for round-trip identity, hash-mismatch fail-soft, missing file, legacy-directory ignore, and absence of credential substrings on disk; update the module contract, map, and change summary.

T-004.Title: Rework family binding lifecycle: rehydrate on restart, fail soft, rebind explicitly, collect garbage.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Bind a family to the current revision at its first workload, resolve the current configuration for a new session, and rehydrate an existing family from its durable pointer after a restart while config edits and /reload leave the binding unchanged.
Remove the candidate, inbox, operation, revision, before-and-after, and cross-context publication machinery and replace it with a per-family serialized bind-on-first-work flow.
A corrupt or missing pointer or snapshot rebinds the affected family to the current configuration with a bounded diagnostic and never throws during plugin load, and unrelated families are unaffected.
Session deletion removes the family pointer; garbage collection removes snapshots unreferenced by any pointer and retains referenced snapshots.
Expose a force-rebind entry point that replaces matching families pointers with the current revision, scoped by project and optionally narrowed to one family.
Add tests covering AC-01, AC-02, AC-06, AC-07, and the force entry point; update the module contract, map, and change summary.

T-005.Title: Wire the binding into the runtime: rehydration, guard, variants, deletion, and rebind application.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Place the binding lookup where /reload cannot reset it, per the T-001 finding, and rehydrate durable pointers on restart.
Rebuild variant registrations from durable bindings and make the model guard accept rehydrated bindings without a stale-expectation failure.

Apply a force rebind by switching only sessions whose resolved selection actually changed; a worker-only rebind leaves the root selection and cache-critical prefix untouched, and child sessions resolve without a guard mismatch.
Subscribe to session deletion so pointer cleanup runs, and add tests covering AC-09 and restart rehydration; update the module contract, map, and change summary.

T-006.Title: Add CLI --force to preset, plugin, and role commands with a scope marker.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add --force to preset apply, plugin enable, plugin disable, role set, and role unset, plus an optional session selector; introduce no new top-level command and preserve existing arguments and output without the flag.

Add a project-scoped marker writer in src/lib/rebind-request.ts carrying scope and optional session, consumed lazily on the family next request; stale markers after a process restart are ignored or cleared.
Add tests for flag parsing, marker content, project and session targeting, and unchanged behavior without the flag; update help text and the module contracts, maps, and change summaries.

T-007.Title: Inject the orchestration policy at the request tail while keeping static guidance in the system prefix.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Move the variable orchestration policy out of the system prefix into a transient request tail, using the shape accepted by the T-001 probe, while static guidance remains in the system prefix.
After a profile rebind the system prefix is byte-identical to before and only the tail block changes, verified through the native request hook.
When the probe shows tail injection is unavailable, implement the documented system-prefix fallback and record the one-time cache cost in design-context.
Add integration tests for the injection placement and the profile-rebind prefix stability, and update the module contract, map, and change summary.

T-008.Title: Make a worker-only model rebind re-resolve bindings without retargeting the root session.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Re-resolve agent bindings and role models from the current configuration on a worker-only rebind and update families without changing the root session selection.
Switch only sessions whose resolved selection actually changed and leave unchanged sessions untouched.
Verify that children created before and after the rebind resolve without a model-guard mismatch.
Add integration tests for worker-only, root-inclusive, and no-op rebind cases; update the module contract, map, and change summary.

T-009.Title: Reconcile GRACE projections and README, add cross-cutting regressions, and run the full gate.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Update .grace/graph/main.xml and .grace/verification/main.xml for the affected modules and scenarios covering restart rehydration, version-independent identity, credential-free snapshots, fail-soft isolation, garbage collection, force semantics, and tail injection.
Update README for the binding lifecycle, the --force flags, restart semantics, and the one-time upgrade rebind.

Add cross-cutting regression tests for a simulated package version and schema URL change, a corrupt family, credential absence in durable artifacts, garbage-collection retention, and restart rehydration.
Run bun run check, bun run build, and bun run e2e:v2 with fresh output; no generated dist file is manually edited and no unrelated file changes.
